_comment: Collection storytelling metadata. Square categories remain the source of truth for which collections exist and which products belong in them. Match entries by exact Square category name (preferred) or handle. Fields: description, heroImage (optional override), featured (homepage). order = display priority; unlisted live categories append alphabetically. Future Square categories listed here unlock copy/hero as soon as products are assigned.
